Vote - Accept-Straight-to-Finalization - Checked on photo and edition. In l. 21, the reference is to BL, not to BGU, and lunate sigma should be avoided.

Commit - At ll. 4, 11 and 38 could safely be assumed χόρτῳ καταβ(ρώματι), cf. P.Berl.Leihg. II 32, 12

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - Thanks for the submission. δρα(γματηγίας) is preferred transcription, as by modern convention the sinusoidal abbreviation is generally transcribed as alpha when it represents alpha (e.g. στρα(τηγῷ), γρα(μματεῖ), etc.). I agree with the transcription σακ(κηγίας) over BL's σακκ̣η̣(γίας); the abbreviation seems to be by (slightly) raised kappa (there is a trace of ink above and to the right, but I don't think it's meaningful). It is good that you've referenced the BL in the correction. Before that, "digital image" instead of "from online photo." Also, make sure to avoid lunate sigmas in papyri.info. Upon resubmission, it would be helpful to enter the other BL corrections to the text, so it can be completely up-to-date and all the changes can be handled together.
Submit - The right interpretation of the line was already published in BL II.2, 33. Nevertheless, I think both δραγματηγιας and σακκηγιας have been there not properly transcribed.

Vote - Return-Straight-to-Sender - Thank you. The readings are good but have already proposed in BL II.2 33. You may consider entering all BL corrections to this text (see https://berlpap.smb.museum/03143/)
